about: Thresholds and word lists for the media asset cleanup. scripts/asset_audit.py reads this file; change a rule here and nowhere else. Each key is explained under notes; references/checks.md says what each finding means.

notes.stale_days: An asset not modified for more than this many days, and not used by a live rule, is listed as stale.
notes.max_grid_slot: The highest grid slot a media rule can use (Discovery's first 72 slots). A slot above this is a finding.
notes.max_slots_per_placement: The most slots one multi-slot placement can span (5x5). More is a finding.
notes.bloomreach_hosts: Image hosts that count as Bloomreach-hosted. An image anywhere else is hot-linked from a third-party site, which can change or remove it (a low finding).
notes.placeholder_hosts: Link and image hosts that are never a real destination.
notes.placeholder_words: Words in a URL's path or query that suggest a placeholder (a medium finding: confirm the real URL).
notes.max_links_to_load: At most this many unique URLs go in links_to_load (images and links from live assets first); the rest are listed in links_over_cap.
notes.max_rule_details_before_asking: If there are more media rules than this to fetch in detail, tell the user how many calls that is and offer to fetch the enabled ones first.
notes.app_hosts: Bloomreach app and dashboard hosts. Links to them (and to any page under /p/<project> on a Bloomreach host) are never loaded: they're reported as not checked. Public CDN images are still checked. Add your instance's app host if it's elsewhere.
notes.token_param_words: A link whose query has a parameter name containing one of these may carry a token or trigger an action, so it's loaded with HEAD only (head_only), never GET or a browser.
notes.redact_param_words: Values of URL parameters whose names contain one of these are replaced with [redacted] in evidence and in the shown form of links.
